title: payload-types.ts stale check failure
body: The quality gate `typecheck` step fails because `src/payload-types.ts` is detected as stale by `scripts/check-types-drift.ts`. This is a pre-existing issue in the repo — schema changes were committed without regenerating types. Fix: run `pnpm generate:types` and commit the updated file.
rationale: The typecheck failure is unrelated to the @ai-summary additions — only JSDoc comments were modified, no schema changes.
